title: Check Mac hardware model and CPU details
summary: Use the sysctl command to find out your Mac's specific model identifier and CPU information. This is useful for checking compatibility or identifying your machine.

steps.explain: Display the Apple model identifier (e.g., MacBookPro18,1).
steps.expect: The model identifier string of your Mac.

steps.explain: Display the CPU brand string (e.g., Apple M1 Pro).
Display available CPU features like MMX, SSE, AES.
steps.expect: A list of supported CPU instruction sets.
